title: 수입인지에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Contract for the Sale of Import Tax)
① Any person who wishes to act as a seller of import tax (excluding electronic import tax) in accordance with Article 4(1) of the Act must submit a contract execution application form (Form 2) to the supplier and the supplier must forward this form to the Bank of Korea. <Amended December 17, 2013>
② Any person who wishes to act as a seller of electronic import tax in accordance with Article 4(1) of the Act must submit a contract execution application form for the sale of electronic import tax to the electronic import tax service provider designated under Article 3(2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "electronic import tax service provider"). In this case, the electronic import tax service provider must verify the requirements of the seller under Article 7 of the Act and then notify the applicant of whether or not the contract will be executed. <Newly added December 17, 2013>
③ The application for contract execution, etc., as specified in paragraph 2, and any other matters necessary for the execution of the contract, and any changes or termination of the contract

The specific procedures required for handling the matter will be determined in consultation between the relevant government agency and the Minister of Finance and Economy. (Established December 17, 2013, January 2, 2026)
